title: Jingzhi Niuhuangjiedu Tablet Ameliorates Oral Mucositis via the AKT/NFkappaB/NLRP3 Signaling Pathway: A Network Pharmacology and Experimental Validation.
authors: Fan, Chunlan; Wang, Hongping; Yin, Qiong; Li, Pin; Ma, Quantao; Lin, Zhaozhou; Zhao, Chen; Peng, Ping; Wang, Zijian; Lv, Yingnan; Wang, Zhibin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药片剂治疗口腔黏膜炎的网络药理学与实验验证，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Oral Mucositis (OM) is a common and highly symptomatic complication of cancer therapy that affects patient function and quality of life. Jingzhi Niuhuangjiedu Tablet (JNT) is derived from the famous Chinese herbal formulas Huanglian Jiedu and Fangfeng Tongsheng decoctions, which have been widely used to treat heat toxin syndrome diseases, such as acute pharyngitis, periodontitis, oral ulcers, and oral mucositis (OM), but the underlying mechanism remains unclear. OBJECTIVES: This study validated the efficacy and explored the potential mechanisms of JNT in the treatment of OM by integrating network pharmacological analyses and experimental verification. METHODS: Network pharmacology and molecular docking techniques were used to predict the active components, key targets, and potential mechanisms of action of JNT against OM. The rat OM model was established by administering 5-Fluorouracil (5-FU) and acetic acid to the rat oral mucosa. Lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-treated human gingival fibroblasts (HGFs) were used as an inflammatory cell model. The GFP-NFkappaB HEK293T cell line was transfected to evaluate the anti-NFkappaB activity of JNT. RESULTS: A total of 236 Chinese herbal components and 201 corresponding targets were predicted for OM treatment using JNT. Bicuculine, luteolin, wogonin, and naringenin were identified as the important active compounds, while AKT1, ALB, IL6, MAPK3, and VEGFA were considered to be the major targets. Molecular docking revealed that these active compounds exhibited strong binding interactions with their targets. In vivo and in vitro experiments demonstrated that the anti-OM effect of JNT might be closely related to AKT1, NFkappaB, caspase-1, and NLRP3, as well as biological processes, such as inflammatory response and oxidative stress. CONCLUSION: Network pharmacological and experimental evidence indicates that JNT has a potential therapeutic effect on OM by regulating the Akt/NFkappaB/NLRP3 pathway.
abstract_zh: 引言：口腔黏膜炎（Oral Mucositis, OM）是癌症治疗中常见且症状显著的并发症，影响患者功能和生活质量。京制牛黄解毒片（JNT）源自著名中药方剂黄连解毒汤和防风通圣散，广泛用于治疗热毒证疾病，如急性咽炎、牙周炎、口腔溃疡和口腔黏膜炎（OM），但其潜在机制尚不明确。目的：本研究通过整合网络药理学分析和实验验证，评估JNT治疗OM的疗效并探索其潜在机制。方法：采用网络药理学和分子对接技术预测JNT抗OM的活性成分、关键靶点及潜在作用机制。通过给予大鼠5-氟尿嘧啶（5-FU）和乙酸建立大鼠OM模型。使用脂多糖（LPS）处理的人牙龈成纤维细胞（HGFs）作为炎症细胞模型。转染GFP-NFkappaB HEK293T细胞系以评估JNT的抗NFkappaB活性。结果：共预测到236种中药成分和201个相应靶点用于JNT治疗OM。荷包牡丹碱、木犀草素、汉黄芩素和柚皮素被鉴定为重要活性化合物，而AKT1、ALB、IL6、MAPK3和VEGFA被视为主要靶点。分子对接显示这些活性化合物与其靶点表现出强结合相互作用。体内和体外实验表明，JNT的抗OM效应可能与AKT1、NFkappaB、caspase-1和NLRP3，以及炎症反应和氧化应激等生物过程密切相关。结论：网络药理学和实验证据表明，JNT通过调节Akt/NFkappaB/NLRP3通路对OM具有潜在治疗作用。
